features.name: Agent Management
features.description: Assign tasks to AI crews, track status, cancel execution, and retrieve agent memory

features.name: Feature Mapping
features.description: Bidirectional mapping between features and source files, auto-maintained by agents and manually refreshable

features.name: Issue Tracking
features.description: Lightweight issue tracking stored in .paaw/ knowledge base with CRUD operations

features.name: Code Health
features.description: Unit test coverage and E2E test results analysis with async run capability

features.name: Agent Memory Panel
features.description: UI panel showing crew agents with avatars, names, and memory entries

features.name: Coding IDE
features.description: Main coding interface with panels for feature mapping, issue tracking, agent memory, and code health

features.name: EM Dashboard
features.description: Engineering Manager dashboard for dispatching tasks to AI crews and monitoring progress

features.name: Night Shift
features.description: Overnight mode where EM leads a 6-agent team for automated work

features.name: .paaw Knowledge Store
features.description: File-based knowledge store for architecture, decisions, feature maps, and issues

features.name: Database Layer
features.description: Provides database connections, migrations, repository implementations, and type definitions for persistent storage

features.name: Context Engine
features.description: Assembles, stores, and refines context information from memory and other sources for agent use

features.name: Engine Core
features.description: Core execution engine that runs workflows, manages tools, and coordinates agent task execution

features.name: Security & Audit
features.description: Manages security policies, secret storage, approval workflows, and audit logging for the platform

features.name: Server Infrastructure
features.description: Provides server-side utilities including LLM utilities, code intelligence, change tracking, semgrep integration, and project management

features.name: Context Engine Server
features.description: Server-side entry point for context engine functionality, bridging context assembly and memory management

features.name: API Routes
features.description: Defines all server API endpoints for agent communication, AI settings, chat, coding, context, workflow, and other platform features

features.name: WebSocket Handler
features.description: Manages real-time WebSocket connections for live updates and bidirectional communication

features.name: Shared Infrastructure
features.description: Provides shared types, schemas, and utility functions used across all packages

features.name: UI Application
features.description: React UI application shell with main App component, API client, and PostCSS configuration

features.name: UI Components
features.description: Reusable React UI components for agent console, browser tools, crew management, file pickers, and various panels

features.name: UI Build Artifacts
features.description: Pre-built UI distribution assets for EmployeeWorkspace and index bundles
